All producer routes, shared semantic validation, and cache failure behavior remain open.

Historical finite quantity wrappers canonicalize signed zero and validate deserialization; manufacturing validation separately bounds construction size, dimensions, identity and attachment structure. Derived f64 geometry is narrowed to f32 at native output; all arithmetic and intermediate finite invariants require connected examination.

Historical holder validation admits recipes using effective component identities, but holder construction selects an original source component and expects its optional explicit ID. This matches recovered 059 record SEGOVB-L12-HOLDER-ORIGINAL-OPTIONAL-ID-EXPECT as a conditional source case, not a new unique historical finding; concrete admission, runtime occurrence and current version need separate proof.

Historical weapon construction validates the recipe, resolves a private assembly, generates high-detail material solids and integrates mass independent of rendering detail. Physical sums and derived outputs, per-part source identity and generated-holder geometry need traced native consumers and meaningful bounds.
Source tests were read, not run. No weapon construction, product build, test, simulation or runtime probe ran.
